nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

after.description: Minimum date, the format is the same as `before`.

assignee.description: Assignee, multiple values separated by commas.

clustered.description: Whether to aggregate by category; upstream currently only supports `true`.

country.description: Country code, multiple values separated by commas, for example `US,CN,WO`.

dups.description: Deduplication method; when not uploading, deduplication is based on patent family, `language` means deduplication is based on public text.

inventor.description: Inventor, multiple values are separated by commas.

language.description: Language, multiple values separated by English commas, use Google Patents official language value.

num.description: Number of results per page, range 10–100.

q.description: Google Patents search query supports official advanced query syntax (such as `owner:"Company"`, `inventor:"Name"`, date operator). Maximum 1000 characters.

scholar.description: Whether to include Google Scholar results.

sort.description: Sorting method: `new` (latest) or `old` (earliest); if not transmitted, sorted by relevance.
